name: Mutsuki Nagi
source:
Chief Operating Officer of SHE

A talented woman who actually manages the business and finances of SHE. She is too young to be a COO, but that is largely due to the influence of the elder Matsunaka who is behind her. She is not a puppet, but she understands Matsunaka's intentions and gives precise instructions for the benefit of the company.

She is one of the people who pushed forward SHE's profit-first nature in a more inconspicuous way than Karl. She stands in the way of Juri, who is trying to oppose SHE, as a formidable wall.

A beautiful woman with a beautiful face like a blade, she seems to have some kind of connection with Touko...?
  "Even a mouse will eat a cat if it is cornered. I will not become complacent, no matter who my opponent is."
